lock.newer: This version of Baobook is older than your data. You can view and export; reload the page to edit.
lock.other: Baobook is open in another tab, and without the browser database only one tab can edit. Here you can view and export; to edit, close that tab and reload this one.
lock.nolock: Without the browser database only one tab can edit, and this browser cannot confirm that this tab is the only one. Here you can view and export.
lock.updated: Baobook was updated in another tab. Reload the page to continue.
lock.unsaved: Baobook was updated in another tab, and the last edit could not be saved. Export it, then reload the page.
lock.epoch: The notes on this device moved to another account in another tab. Reload the page to continue.
lock.blocked: Another Baobook tab keeps the storage from being set up. Close the other Baobook tabs and reload the page.
lock.say: View only for now — reload the page to edit
lock.storage: The browser storage did not open, so the notes on this device cannot be read right now. Reload the page; if that does not help, close the app and open it again.
lock.storageBack: The browser storage is available again. Reload the page to continue.
lock.waitTab: Another Baobook tab or the installed app is open and holding the storage, so it cannot be updated. Switch to it for a moment or close it, and this page will continue by itself.
lock.waitSilent: Another Baobook tab or the installed app seems to be open and asleep, so the storage cannot be updated. Switch to it for a moment or close it, and this page will continue by itself.
lock.waitLong: The storage still could not be opened. Close the other Baobook tabs and the app; if that does not help, close the app completely and open it again.
lock.waitHeld: The storage check has been waiting for more than {wait}. Another Baobook window that the browser has put to sleep, such as a tab left open, may be holding the storage. The app will go on by itself as soon as the storage is free.
lock.waitHeldAndroid: To skip the wait, you can stop Chrome in the Android settings («Force stop») and open the app again.

empty.help: The sheet is empty and takes the whole screen. Text snaps to the grid, blocks never overlap. Pasted code becomes a locked code block. Drag the mouse over an empty spot to draw an area: put blocks in it and move it as a whole. Hover over a line to see the ⋮⋮ handle — drag it to move the line.The «+» button at the bottom adds a block at the end. Hold your finger on an empty spot and drag to draw an area for blocks (it is also in the «⋯» menu at the top). Drag a line by the ⋮⋮ handle next to it.
